name: document-from-source
title_zh: 先打真实 API 再落笔的 Jupiter 文档工
tagline_zh: 写 Jupiter API 文档不再靠猜：它先探活接口、跑真交易，再对照 SDK 和前端源码，最后才落笔。
tagline_en: Stop guessing API docs: it probes endpoints, runs real txs, cross-checks SDK & FE source, then writes. For.
desc_en: Document a Jupiter API/feature from verifiable evidence instead of assumptions. Probes the live API, optionally runs the real transaction lifecycle on mainnet from the operator's workbench, cross-references the SDK and first-party FE source, then writes docs, product-learning entries, a DX findings file, and a changelog entry. Use when documenting a new or changed endpoint/feature where behaviour
why_zh: 文档从可验证证据生成，而非假设；机制上强制先探活再写，杜绝过时或臆测内容。
why_en: Docs built from verifiable evidence, not assumptions. Forces live probing before writing, killing stale or invented content.
limit_zh: 仅适用于 Jupiter API/feature 文档，需能访问主网和操作员工作台；不覆盖其他项目或离线场景。
limit_en: Only for Jupiter API/feature docs; needs mainnet access & operator workbench. Not for other projects or offline use.
title_en: Jupiter doc writer that probes live API first
